title: FORGETFUL BUT FAITHFUL: A COGNITIVE MEMORY ARCHITECTURE AND BENCHMARK FOR PRIVACY-AWARE GENERATIVE AGENTS
reasoning: The paper introduces the FiFA benchmark, which evaluates Large Language Model-based generative agents on several criteria, including 'privacy preservation.' It operationalizes ethical and legal standards like the 'right to be forgotten' (GDPR) and 'responsible AI' governance as core evaluative metrics alongside functional performance.
